authority: Root authorized prospective recovery and early neutral recipe/policy lock; no further root Go
current_stage_objective: Deliver actual required stage artifacts and useful complete current content across the full brief, with honest source limits/unresolved dependencies; planning/review maps alone are insufficient
chronological_selection: First compatible immutable materially usable same-arm native-candidate role by original birth time/job-id tie-break; no quality, grade or best-of selection

development_recovery.four_research_roles: Carry exact same-arm research and legitimate source context through fresh native critic/final roles; reuse only genuinely compatible existing roles
development_recovery.proposal_only: Finite candidate-native research consolidation of missing catalogs/context, then actual remaining declared roles; do not label partial input completed research
development_recovery.no_proposal_or_maps_only: Scope-correct fresh research/pipeline version; a fresh matched pair is required for new matched-comparison credit
development_recovery.provenance: Actual affordable-candidate authorship, Goal activation, original status/bytes/costs and timely owned quiescence required; preserve incomplete origin flags
development_recovery.budgets: Use each source card's unchanged per-role and pipeline allocation, including V05 treatment/other declared topology; no blanket 900/600 override
development_recovery.new_clock: Each new assignment has its own prospectively frozen finite clock; original clocks/outcomes never reopened
development_recovery.cumulative_cost: Include all original and recovery work; outside-original-allocation recovery is separately identified, never an original-budget win

counting.original_attempt_status: Immutable FAILED/HOLD/COMPLETED record; terminal failure is not completed pipeline
counting.delivered_full_workflow: Count only actual source selection/investigation, plan comparison, candidate checking/repair and genuine native final delivery of all four current artifacts with required roles and owned closure
counting.recovered_delivery: May be a completed delivered end-to-end workflow in its explicit recovery lineage; label recovered/warm and preserve all origins/costs

confirmation_policy.within_locked_allowance: Usable genuine same-arm partial material may be carried into the scheduled remaining roles under their fixed caps; phase failure stays recorded. Do not fake missing roles or add time/helpers outside the locked allowance
confirmation_policy.exhausted_or_no_usable_material: Locked arm remains FAILED/INCOMPLETE if complete delivery cannot be achieved within the frozen recipe; separate recovery cannot silently qualify it
confirmation_policy.structural_repair: A concrete code/composition failure may justify a new declared matched repetition with same locked meaning/model/tools/bounds and fresh contemporaneous controls; retain original result/cost, no source-quality feedback or answers
